units.source_text: 他悄悄地离开竹篱，走到外面，遣人走马返京，叫家中派车来宇治迎接。

en.t: He quietly left the bamboo fence, went outside, and sent a man riding back to the capital to have a carriage sent from his house to Uji to fetch him.

units.source_text: 又对那个值宿人说：“此来时机不巧，未能会见亲王。

en.t: He also said to the night attendant, "The timing of this visit was unfortunate, and I was unable to meet the prince.

units.source_text: 但得听小姐琴声，反觉三生有幸，遗憾亦得稍慰矣。

en.t: Yet merely hearing the young ladies play the koto felt like a blessing from three lifetimes, and it has somewhat eased my regret.

units.source_text: 相烦通报小姐，容我罄诉冒霜犯露而来之苦。”

en.t: Please trouble yourself to inform the young ladies, and allow me to tell them fully of the hardship I endured in coming here through frost and dew."

units.source_text: 值宿人立刻进去通报。

en.t: The night attendant immediately went inside to deliver the message.

units.source_text: 两位女公子想不到他会进来窥探，担心适才逸居晏处之状已被看到，深感羞耻。

en.t: The two young ladies had not imagined that he would come in and spy on them, and they were deeply ashamed, fearing he had seen them just now in their relaxed privacy.

units.source_text: 回思那时确有异香随风飘来，因在意想不到之时，竟不警觉，真乃太疏忽了。

en.t: Thinking back, they remembered that a strange fragrance had indeed drifted in on the wind, but because it happened so unexpectedly, they had failed to notice; it had been terribly careless.

units.source_text: 心中惑乱，愈觉羞惭无地。

en.t: Their hearts were thrown into confusion, and they felt more and more ashamed, as if there were nowhere to hide.

units.source_text: 薰君看见传达的侍女动作迟钝，呼应不灵，因念凡事都该随机应变，不可拘泥礼法。

en.t: Kaoru saw that the maid conveying the message was slow and unresponsive, and he thought that in all things one should adapt to the moment rather than cling rigidly to etiquette.

units.source_text: 反正夜雾尚未消散，便径自走到刚才女公子等所居房室帘前，就在那里坐下。

en.t: Since the night mist had not yet cleared, he went straight to the curtain before the room where the young ladies had just been staying and sat down there.

units.source_text: 几个山乡的青年侍女不知该如何应对，便送出一个蒲团来，态度也很慌张。

en.t: Several young maids from the mountain village did not know how to respond, so they brought out a cushion, but their manner was very flustered.

units.source_text: 薰君开言道：“叫我坐在帘外，未免太简慢了。

en.t: Kaoru began to speak: "Making me sit outside the curtain is surely far too cold a reception.

units.source_text: 若非真心诚意之人，不会跋涉崎岖之山路，前来寻访。

en.t: No one without true sincerity would cross such rugged mountain roads to come here in search of you.

units.source_text: 这待遇太不相称了。

en.t: This treatment is much too unequal to my devotion.

units.source_text: 我屡次冒霜犯露而来，小姐必然能体谅我心也。”

en.t: I have come here again and again through frost and dew; surely the young ladies can understand my heart."

units.source_text: 说时态度十分庄重。

en.t: As he spoke, his bearing was extremely solemn.

units.source_text: 青年侍女之中，没有一人善于应对，大家都想钻进地洞里才好，实在太不成样了。

en.t: Among the young maids, not one was skilled at replying, and they all wished they could crawl into a hole; it was truly a sorry sight.

units.source_text: 便有人到里面去叫起睡着的老侍女来，但她起身也颇费时。

en.t: So someone went inside to wake the sleeping old maid, but even getting her up took quite some time.

units.source_text: 久不答复，似乎有意怠慢。

en.t: With no reply for so long, it seemed almost as if they were deliberately slighting him.

units.source_text: 苦无办法，于是大女公子说道：“都是些不懂事的人，怎么能装作懂事，出去应对呢？”

en.t: At a loss for what to do, the elder young lady said, "They are all people who understand nothing; how could they pretend to understand and go out to answer him?"

units.source_text: 这声音非常高尚优雅，轻微得几乎听不出来。

en.t: Her voice was exceptionally noble and graceful, but so faint that it could hardly be heard.

units.source_text: 薰君说道：“据我所知，懂得人之苦心而装作不懂，乃世人之常习。

en.t: Kaoru said, "As far as I know, it is the common habit of the world to understand another person's pain and pretend not to understand.

units.source_text: 大小姐也漠然装作不懂，实甚遗憾。

en.t: It is deeply regrettable that even the elder young lady should coldly pretend not to understand.

units.source_text: 亲王大智大慧，彻悟佛道。

en.t: The prince possesses great wisdom and insight, and has fully awakened to the Buddhist path.

units.source_text: 小姐朝夕侍侧，久受熏陶，料想其对世间万事皆已洞察。

en.t: Since the young ladies have served by his side morning and evening and long received his influence, I imagine they have already seen through all matters of the world.

units.source_text: 我有难于隐忍的一点心事，值得小姐洞察。

en.t: There is one feeling in my heart that I can hardly keep hidden, and it is worthy of the young ladies' understanding.

units.source_text: 请勿视我为世间寻常好色之人。

en.t: Please do not regard me as an ordinary lustful man of the world.

units.source_text: 婚娶之事，曾有人专诚相劝，但我立志坚强，决不从命。

en.t: As for marriage, people have earnestly urged it on me before, but my resolve has been firm, and I have never obeyed.

units.source_text: 此种消息，小姐自然早已闻知。

en.t: The young ladies have surely heard such reports already.

units.source_text: 我所希望的，只是闲居寂处之时，得与卿等共话。

en.t: What I hope for is only that, in quiet and secluded moments, I might be allowed to converse with you.

units.source_text: 卿等山居沉闷之时，亦复随时见招，以资排遣。

en.t: And when life in the mountains feels dull to you, you may call for me at any time to help relieve your boredom.

units.source_text: 但得如此，于愿足矣。”

en.t: If only that much were granted, my wish would be fully satisfied."

units.source_text: 他说了一大篇话，但大女公子只管怕羞，一句话也不能回答。

en.t: He spoke at great length, but the elder young lady was so overcome with shyness that she could not answer a single word.

units.source_text: 此时老侍女已经起身出来，就让她前去应对。

en.t: By then the old maid had already risen and come out, so they had her go forward to reply to him.
